t_advice_summary_textbox.text: There are two gnomes, one gnome will give consistentlu more  mushrooms than the other. When that gnome starts giving less mushrooms, you must find another gnome to give you more mushrooms.

vb_textbox.text: During the game there will be two gnomes of different colours appear on the screen. You need to press one and you will be awarded points. If you get a gnome with a high point score, pick this gnome again when you see the same colour appear. After a while the gnome of that co,our will start giving lower points. You then need to choose another colour  gnome to receive high points. Collect as many points as possible to  receive a bonus.
